scope: PF training and VOF evaluation source inspected separately; movies and binary arrays/checkpoints unopened.

unresolved_findings.finding: No repository license is detected at the pinned snapshot.
No installation recipe, environment manifest or exact package versions are supplied.
The PF entrypoint requires three unbundled PF arrays; bundled VOF arrays cannot substitute for method/interval-specific PF inputs.
VOF evaluation and generation require an unbundled rising_bubble.h5 CFD reference; binary shapes/content and selected physical times remain unvalidated.
Absolute author paths, required output directories, CUDA PF execution and video tooling require downstream setup; actual hardware is unknown.
No complete LS training or multi-interval driver is present; result movies do not establish a full sequential reproduction workflow.
PF checkpoint omits the sixteen external adaptive scalars and optimizer/scheduler state; adaptive weighting has no explicit guard against zero denominators.
VOF deserialization lacks map_location and uses bespoke zero handling for relative-error maps; no quantitative acceptance threshold is supplied.
